_about: Generated by tools/build_component_tokens.py from raw/css-vars.json and raw/components-computed.json; resolved into tokens.json by tools/build_tokens.py. Edit the builder, never this file.

palette.$description: The literal role palettes every EGDS theme binds: 57 colours each (primary/secondary/tertiary, containers and variants, on- colours, surfaces at three elevations, outline, scrim/shadow and the status set critical/positive/featured/info). [data-theme-light|dark] rebinds the --egds-* semantic names to one of these; light1 is the signed-out page theme.

color.$description: Every colour literal the stylesheets declare lives here; the themed sets hold the --egds-* semantic roles that alias into it.

type.$description: The --egds-type-style-* declarations: display is Reckless XPD, headline and text are Centra No2. display has small/medium sizes, headline small/medium/large/extra-large/overline, text small/medium/large (each with a variant line-height).

typography.$description: Composed type styles (EGDS type-style): use these for text, not the raw pieces.

font.$description: The older --font__* scale (numeric size x weight names, stacks and line-heights), still declared on :root.

typographyLegacy.$description: The older --typography__* display/body/utility scale, still declared on :root.

spacing.$description: The --egds-spacing-* semantic names, aliases onto spacing.* through --standard__spacing__*.

sizing.$description: The --sizing__* step scale (0x..128x, quarters and halves).

opacity.$description: The --opacity__* steps; percent values become the number they mean (disabled 0.4).

easing.$description: The --easing__* keyword easings (enter ease-out, exit ease-in, standard ease).

fontFace.$description: The --font_face__* family stacks (Centra No2, Reckless XPD) EGDS declares per role.

standard.$description: The --standard__* binding layer: the standard theme's spacing/font assignments the --egds-spacing-* and type roles read through.

motion.$description: Movement/appearance presets: a duration plus a cubic-bezier, kept as the raw string (DTCG transition carries no string pair).

measured.$description: Values that are not one variable, measured on components in raw/components-computed.json; each names the component and state.

_gaps.why: search-submit focus-visible draws the browser's default focus ring (outline 5px auto rgb(16, 16, 16)); the declared --egds-outline-focus is not what paints
search-submit default paints no colour there ('rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)')
search-shell default paints no colour there (None)
